title: 7 Things Scripture Actually Calls a Man's Work
caption:
7 things Scripture actually calls a man's work. Hint: your paycheck isn't on the list.

Working as if God's the one signing off, not your boss, Colossians calls it working for the Lord. Doing the job right when no one's checking. Providing without needing credit for it. Finishing what you start, especially the boring part. Serving somebody who can't pay you back. Showing up early enough it's never a scramble.

And resting on purpose, not just when you crash. Even God stopped.
